expansion: Live contentedly, organize wisely, quality instead of quantity
tagline: The guide for a calm everyday life: good habits, less ballast and more time for what is important to you
description: ZUFIQ is a guide for a calm, contented life: routines for morning and evening, decluttering and organization systems, digital peace, conscious consumption, time and energy management and sleep as a habit, explained in thorough, everyday instructions.
author: ZUFIQ editorial team

gewohnheiten-und-routinen.name: Habits & Routines
gewohnheiten-und-routinen.description: Morning routine and evening routine, building new habits, letting go of old ones and finding a weekly rhythm: small steps that make everyday life quieter and more reliable.

ausmisten-und-minimalismus.name: Decluttering & minimalism
ausmisten-und-minimalismus.description: Clear out room by room, wardrobe, memorabilia and gifts: minimalism without dogma, so that what you really use, need or love remains.

ordnung-und-papierkram.name: Order & paperwork
ordnung-und-papierkram.description: Organization systems for the kitchen, hallway, bathroom and storage room, fixed places and labels as well as a shelf for paperwork and documents that will last even in busy everyday life.

digitale-ruhe.name: Digital peace
digitale-ruhe.description: Less screen time, silent notifications, a tidy email inbox and ordering photos and files: ways to calmly use your cell phone and computer.

bewusster-konsum.name: Conscious consumption
bewusster-konsum.description: Make purchasing decisions calmly, curb spontaneous purchases, check subscriptions, care for things and pass them on: consume consciously without experiencing deprivation as a punishment.

zeit-energie-und-schlaf.name: Time, energy & sleep
zeit-energie-und-schlaf.description: Plan your day realistically, set priorities, take breaks, organize your energy and cultivate sleep as a habit: for days with more air and evenings with real rest.
